isolation: All disposable homes, Git repositories, metadata, status streams and request tracing lived under the worktree. GitHub calls were read-only public API requests through the installed gh-axi; the tracer delegates with exec and does not alter responses. No harness, Herdr, default tmux server, production fleet home, or pipeline lifecycle was driven.
setup_adjustments: The initial absent tmux socket used an overlong absolute Unix-socket pathname; switching to a worktree-relative private absent socket corrected endpoint observation. A ship fixture initially omitted its worktree metadata field; supplying the public field exposed its unpublished commit. Initial done/paused status events correctly produced unrelated completion/signal wakes; a fresh paused fixture and real fm-wake-drain acknowledgment isolated the subsequent no-ledger-wake observation.
